claims.claim: Rhythm is a visual tempo or flow created by repeated elements.
Repetition, pattern, rhythm, and movement are related but distinguishable design terms.
Repeated elements can create a sense of visual movement in an artwork.
Formal observations of rhythm support claims about visual flow but not fixed emotion, intent, or symbolism.
Rhythm can be regular, alternating, progressive, or interrupted depending on interval and variation.
